title: 2026 CBAM Carbon Price Relief verification QA controls

sources.title: What you need to work out Carbon Price Relief
Get a carbon pricing verification form

facts.source_fact: Carbon Price Relief applies to qualifying carbon-pricing costs for CBAM goods under the published rules.
facts.expected_handling: Apply relief logic only to in-scope CBAM goods and qualifying schemes.

facts.source_fact: A completed carbon-pricing verification form is required to work out Carbon Price Relief.
facts.expected_handling: Block relief calculation where required verification evidence is absent.

facts.source_fact: The form can be obtained directly from the manufacturing or processing installation or through the supply chain.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve evidence-chain provenance.

facts.source_fact: A verification form is required for each CBAM good for which relief is claimed, including relevant intermediate-good cases.
facts.expected_handling: Bind verification evidence to the specific good.

facts.source_fact: The carbon-pricing verification form must be completed correctly by a verification body meeting the relevant standards.
facts.expected_handling: Require verifier qualification evidence.

facts.source_fact: The verification form does not contain all information needed; qualifying-scheme public information is also required.
facts.expected_handling: Do not calculate relief from the form alone.

facts.source_fact: Public information needed can include the headline carbon price.
facts.expected_handling: Store scheme, currency, period and source with the price.

facts.source_fact: Public information can include graduated carbon prices where applicable.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute headline price for a graduated-price case.

facts.source_fact: Compensation received or due can form part of the public information needed for relief calculations.
facts.expected_handling: Keep compensation evidence separate from gross carbon price.

facts.source_fact: Recognised greenhouse-gas-removal prices can be relevant where the qualifying scheme allows them.
facts.expected_handling: Require scheme recognition before including GGR payments.

facts.source_fact: Required public information should be published by the scheme administrator or organisations publishing on its behalf.
facts.expected_handling: Reject unsupported private price assertions.

facts.source_fact: Prices for emissions subject to free allowances do not need to be included in the relief price calculation under the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Exclude free-allowance portions as directed by the rule.

facts.source_fact: Emissions beneath the relevant carbon-pricing threshold are not included when working out the relief under the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Apply scheme threshold before price aggregation.

facts.source_fact: If required scheme price information is not publicly available, the scheme does not qualify for Carbon Price Relief under this guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Block relief rather than inventing missing price data.

facts.source_fact: The headline carbon price uses the mean average over the calendar quarter prior to the point of import.
facts.expected_handling: Use the correct prior-quarter time window.

facts.source_fact: Graduated prices likewise use the mean average over the prior calendar quarter.
facts.expected_handling: Calculate graduated-price averages using the correct period.

facts.source_fact: A GGR price used for relief must have been made publicly available by the relevant GGR provider.
facts.expected_handling: Require public provider-price provenance.

facts.source_fact: Only GGR payments recognised by a qualifying carbon-pricing scheme are in scope for relief.
facts.expected_handling: Do not include voluntary removal payments without scheme recognition.

facts.source_fact: The relief calculation period is anchored to the point of import of the CBAM good.
facts.expected_handling: Store import date with price-window calculations.

facts.source_fact: Relief is calculated only after the verification form and required public-price inputs have been assembled.
facts.expected_handling: Separate evidence collection from final relief calculation.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach CBAM good, installation, scheme and import boundary.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents cross-good or cross-scheme price mixing.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach import date, prior quarter and guidance vintage.
Carry verification-form, verifier and public-price source provenance.
Do not convert CBAM tax-relief evidence into parcel-level measured emissions.
